title: The Infinitesimal Structure of Quantum Information
abstract: This paper establishes a rigorous, unified geometric framework for quantum state spaces by constructing smooth, regular embeddings into higher-order dual number algebras $\mathcal{Q}_N \equiv \mathbb{R}[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^{N^2-1})$, wherein every quantum state is faithfully represented as a non-reduced scheme-theoretic point. We show that under this unified family of truncated rings, the non-linear matrix commutators governing the Liouville-von Neumann dynamics map globally onto flat, linear, and rigid algebraic flows, establishing nilpotent dual algebras as a pristine geometric landscape for higher-dimensional quantum kinematics.
summary: This work develops an advanced geometric framework using higher-order dual number algebras to represent the state space of quantum systems. It shows that complex, non-linear quantum dynamics can be mapped onto simple, flat, linear flows in this specialized algebraic setting. This offers a powerful, unified mathematical language for studying quantum kinematics.
main_problem: The paper aims to establish a rigorous, unified geometric framework for quantum state spaces by embedding them into higher-order dual number algebras.
main_result: It demonstrates that the non-linear Liouville-von Neumann dynamics map globally onto flat, linear, and rigid algebraic flows within these nilpotent dual algebras.
method: The core method involves constructing gauge-invariant density map embeddings ($\Psi_{Q_N}$) from the physical projective Hilbert space $	ext{P}(H_N)$ into truncated polynomial rings $Q_N$.
model_or_system: The system analyzed is the quantum state space of an N-level system (e.g., qubits, qutrits), whose dynamics are governed by the Liouville-von Neumann equation.
key_observables: Fubini-Study metric ($ds^2_{FS}$), density matrix $ho$, and related geometric scaling factors ($\omega_N$).
important_parameters: The dimension $N$ of the system, which dictates the order of nilpotency in the dual algebra ($\varepsilon^{N^2-1}=0$).
main_assumptions: It assumes that using non-reduced schemes and nilpotent dual number algebras provides a complete, non-singular container for all physical degrees of freedom.

paper_structure: The paper builds from abstract algebraic structures (Grothendieck schemes, dual algebras) to physical systems ($	ext{P}(H_N)$), using the density embedding map as the unifying tool across different dimensions $N$.
why_interesting: It provides a highly abstract yet powerful mathematical machinery that unifies quantum geometry and dynamics by translating non-linear evolution into linear algebraic flows within nilpotent structures.
